build_wizard_of_internet_dataset: build the wizard of internet dataset by downloading and extracting data files to the datapath directory
run_build_function: run the build function to download the wizard of internet dataset tgz file and mark it done
download_DATASET_FILE: download the wizard of internet dataset file using the DATASET_FILE downloadable file object
review_build_function: review the build function that handles dataset download, directory creation, and version marking
summarize_DATASET_FILE: summarize the DATASET_FILE object that configures the wizard of internet dataset download URL and checksum
